jobs.title: Tutor
jobs.reason: This is a client-training tutor / assessor contract role based in Shanghai, entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and geopolitical-risk zones, and almost certainly requiring Mandarin and specialist assurance/training expertise the candidate lacks. It offers no paper fit or interest alignment and is not a realistic target.

jobs.title: Contractor - IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: A "Lead Auditor" role requiring deep specialist expertise in automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, AIAG core tools, OEM requirements) — this is neither entry-level nor within the candidate's competence, and the seniority/experience bar is a hard mismatch. It also sits entirely outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it is a speculative/expert-appointment posting with no clear salaried vacancy, and it seeks established specialists rather than an early-career candidate. Although human rights and securitisation are core-interest topics, the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.
